functions.name: is_teacher_of_class
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_teacher_of_class(target_class uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.classes c
    where c.id=target_class
      and (
        c.teacher_id=auth.uid()
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.class_teacher_links l
          where l.class_id=c.id and l.user_id=auth.uid()
        )
      )
  );
$function$

functions.name: is_child_student
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_child_student(target_student uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.student_device_links l
      where l.student_id = target_student
        and l.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.students s
      where s.id = target_student
        and s.child_user_id = auth.uid()
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_student_progress()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.student_progress(student_id, shells)
  values (new.id, 0)
  on conflict (student_id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_auth_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_teacher boolean;
begin
  v_teacher := coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'account_type','') = 'teacher';

  insert into public.profiles(id, role, display_name, must_change_password)
  values (
    new.id,
    case when v_teacher then 'teacher' else 'student' end,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name', ''),
    v_teacher
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_class(target_class uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    public.is_teacher_of_class(target_class)
    or exists(
      select 1
      from public.students s
      where s.class_id=target_class
        and (
          public.is_child_student(s.id)
          or exists(
            select 1 from public.parent_student_links l
            where l.student_id=s.id and l.parent_user_id=auth.uid()
          )
        )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_child_devices(p_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_teacher_of_student(p_student_id) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung für dieses Kind';
  end if;

  delete from public.student_device_links
  where student_id = p_student_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_class_admin(target_class uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.classes c
    where c.id=target_class
      and (
        c.teacher_id=auth.uid()
        or (
          c.school_id is not null
          and exists(
            select 1
            from public.school_members sm
            where sm.school_id=c.school_id

              and sm.role='admin'
          )

functions.name: update_class_settings
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_class_settings(p_class_id uuid, p_name text, p_school_year text, p_grade_level smallint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_class_admin(p_class_id) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung';
  end if;
  if btrim(coalesce(p_name,''))='' then raise exception 'Name fehlt'; end if;

  update public.classes
  set name=btrim(p_name),
      school_year=coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_school_year),''),school_year),
      grade_level=p_grade_level
  where id=p_class_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: list_school_members
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_school_members(p_school_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, email text, role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists(
    select 1
    from public.school_members sm
    where sm.school_id=p_school_id
      and sm.user_id=auth.uid()
  ) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    u.id,
    coalesce(nullif(p.display_name,''),u.email)::text,
    u.email::text,
    sm.role::text
  from public.school_members sm
  join auth.users u on u.id=sm.user_id
  left join public.profiles p on p.id=u.id
  where sm.school_id=p_school_id
  order by sm.role,coalesce(nullif(p.display_name,''),u.email);
end;
$function$

functions.name: update_school_admin_settings
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_school_admin_settings(p_school_id uuid, p_name text, p_default_school_year text, p_default_retention_days integer, p_teachers_can_create_classes boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_school_admin(p_school_id) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung';
  end if;

  if btrim(coalesce(p_name,''))='' then raise exception 'Name fehlt'; end if;
  if p_default_retention_days < 7 or p_default_retention_days > 1095 then
    raise exception 'Ungültige Löschfrist';
  end if;

  update public.schools
  set name=btrim(p_name)
  where id=p_school_id;

  insert into public.school_settings(
    school_id,default_school_year,default_retention_days,teachers_can_create_classes,updated_at
  )
  values(
    p_school_id,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_default_school_year),''),'2026/27'),
    p_default_retention_days,
    coalesce(p_teachers_can_create_classes,false),
    now()
  )
  on conflict(school_id)
  do update set
    default_school_year=excluded.default_school_year,
    default_retention_days=excluded.default_retention_days,
    teachers_can_create_classes=excluded.teachers_can_create_classes,
    updated_at=now();
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reset_child_qr_code(p_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(qr_token text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Keine Anmeldung vorhanden';
  end if;

  if coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean, false) = true then
    raise exception 'Nur Lehrkräfte dürfen QR-Codes erneuern';
  end if;

  if not public.is_teacher_of_student(p_student_id) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung für dieses Kind';
  end if;

  insert into public.stable_child_qr_codes(student_id, code, active, updated_at)
  values (p_student_id, gen_random_uuid(), true, now())
  on conflict (student_id)
  do update set
    code = gen_random_uuid(),
    active = true,
    updated_at = now();

  update public.child_access_codes
  set active = false
  where student_id = p_student_id
    and active = true;

  return query
  select q.code::text
  from public.stable_child_qr_codes q
  where q.student_id = p_student_id
    and q.active = true;
end;
$function$

    c.id,
    c.name,
    wp.goal,

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.students s
    join public.classes c on c.id=s.class_id
    where s.id=p_student_id
      and s.archived_at is null
      and c.archived_at is null
      and (
        public.is_teacher_of_class(c.id)
        or (c.school_id is not null and public.is_school_admin(c.school_id))
        or (
          c.school_id is not null
          and c.grade_level is not null
          and public.has_grade_access(c.school_id,c.grade_level)
        )
      )
  );

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_grade_plan_students_v2(p_school_id uuid, p_grade_level smallint, p_week_start date, p_weekday smallint)
 RETURNS TABLE(student_id uuid, display_name text, avatar_emoji text, class_id uuid, class_name text, goal text, help_text text, checkin_completed boolean, checkin_feeling text, checkout_self text, checkout_decision text, checkout_note text, today_rated_count integer, today_enabled_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_grade_access(p_school_id,p_grade_level) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung für diese Stufe';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    s.id,
    s.display_name,
    s.avatar_emoji,
    c.id,
    c.name,
    wp.goal,
    wp.help_text,
    wp.checkin_completed,
    wp.checkin_feeling,
    wp.checkout_self,
    wp.checkout_decision,
    wp.checkout_note,
    case
      when p_weekday between 1 and 5 then
        (
          select count(*)::integer
          from public.ratings r
          where r.student_id=s.id
            and r.week_start=p_week_start
            and r.weekday=p_weekday
        )
      else 0
    end as today_rated_count,
    case
      when p_weekday between 1 and 5 then
        (
          select count(*)::integer
          from generate_series(1,8) g(lesson_no)
          where not exists(
            select 1
            from public.student_schedule_slots ss
            where ss.student_id=s.id
              and ss.weekday=p_weekday
              and ss.lesson_no=g.lesson_no
              and ss.enabled=false
          )
        )
      else 0
    end as today_enabled_count
  from public.classes c
  join public.students s
    on s.class_id=c.id
   and s.archived_at is null
  left join public.weekly_plans wp
    on wp.student_id=s.id
   and wp.week_start=p_week_start
  where c.school_id=p_school_id
    and c.grade_level=p_grade_level
    and c.archived_at is null
  order by c.name,s.sort_order,s.display_name;
end;
$function$

functions.name: save_student_observation_v2
get_student_development
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_student_development(p_student_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_student jsonb;
  v_weeks jsonb;
  v_observations jsonb;
  v_goal_summary jsonb;
  v_totals jsonb;
begin
  if not public.can_teacher_access_student(p_student_id) then
    raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from>p_to or p_to-p_from>400 then
    raise exception 'Ungültiger Zeitraum';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id',s.id,
    'display_name',s.display_name,
    'avatar_emoji',s.avatar_emoji,
    'class_name',c.name,
    'grade_level',c.grade_level,
    'school_id',c.school_id
  )
  into v_student
  from public.students s
  join public.classes c on c.id=s.class_id
  where s.id=p_student_id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_data order by (row_data->>'week_start')::date),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_weeks
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'week_start',wp.week_start,
      'goal',wp.goal,
      'help_text',wp.help_text,
      'checkin_feeling',wp.checkin_feeling,
      'checkin_completed',wp.checkin_completed,
      'checkout_self',wp.checkout_self,
      'checkout_decision',wp.checkout_decision,
      'checkout_note',wp.checkout_note,
      'good_count',(select count(*) from public.ratings r where r.student_id=wp.student_id and r.week_start=wp.week_start and r.rating='good'),
      'partial_count',(select count(*) from public.ratings r where r.student_id=wp.student_id and r.week_start=wp.week_start and r.rating='partial'),
      'difficult_count',(select count(*) from public.ratings r where r.student_id=wp.student_id and r.week_start=wp.week_start and r.rating='difficult'),
      'rated_count',(select count(*) from public.ratings r where r.student_id=wp.student_id and r.week_start=wp.week_start)
    ) as row_data
    from public.weekly_plans wp
    where wp.student_id=p_student_id
      and wp.week_start between p_from - 6 and p_to
  ) q;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id',o.id,
      'observed_on',o.observed_on,
      'week_start',o.week_start,
      'goal_snapshot',o.goal_snapshot,
      'category',o.category,
      'segment_no',o.segment_no,
      'note',o.note,
      'created_at',o.created_at,
      'can_delete',(o.created_by=auth.uid() or (c.school_id is not null and public.is_school_admin(c.school_id)))
    )
    order by o.observed_on desc,o.created_at desc
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_observations
  from public.student_observations o
  join public.students s on s.id=o.student_id
  join public.classes c on c.id=s.class_id
  where o.student_id=p_student_id
    and o.observed_on between p_from and p_to;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object('goal',goal,'weeks',weeks)
    order by weeks desc,goal
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_goal_summary
  from (
    select wp.goal,count(*)::integer weeks
    from public.weekly_plans wp
    where wp.student_id=p_student_id
      and wp.week_start between p_from - 6 and p_to
    group by wp.goal
  ) g;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'good_count',count(*) filter(where r.rating='good'),
    'partial_count',count(*) filter(where r.rating='partial'),
    'difficult_count',count(*) filter(where r.rating='difficult'),
    'rated_count',count(r.id),
    'weeks_with_plan',(
      select count(*)
      from public.weekly_plans wp
      where wp.student_id=p_student_id
        and wp.week_start between p_from - 6 and p_to
    ),
    'checkouts',(
      select count(*)
      from public.weekly_plans wp
      where wp.student_id=p_student_id
        and wp.week_start between p_from - 6 and p_to
        and wp.checkout_self is not null
    ),
    'observations',(
      select count(*)
      from public.student_observations o
      where o.student_id=p_student_id
        and o.observed_on between p_from and p_to
    )
  )
  into v_totals
  from public.ratings r
  where r.student_id=p_student_id
    and r.week_start between p_from - 6 and p_to;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'student',v_student,
    'from',p_from,
    'to',p_to,
    'weeks',v_weeks,
    'observations',v_observations,
    'goal_summary',v_goal_summary,
    'totals',v_totals
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.grade_get_student_week(p_student_id uuid, p_week_start date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_school uuid;v_grade smallint;v_class_id uuid;v_class_name text;v_name text;v_avatar text;v_plan jsonb;
begin
 select c.school_id,c.grade_level,c.id,c.name,s.display_name,s.avatar_emoji
 into v_school,v_grade,v_class_id,v_class_name,v_avatar
 from public.students s join public.classes c on c.id=s.class_id
 where s.id=p_student_id and s.archived_at is null and c.archived_at is null;
 if auth.uid() is null or v_school is null or v_grade is null or not public.has_grade_access(v_school,v_grade) then raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung für diese Stufe'; end if;
 select to_jsonb(wp) into v_plan from public.weekly_plans wp where wp.student_id=p_student_id and wp.week_start=p_week_start;
 return jsonb_build_object(
 'student',jsonb_build_object('id',p_student_id,'display_name',v_name,'avatar_emoji',v_avatar,'class_id',v_class_id,'class_name',v_class_name,'grade_level',v_grade),
 'plan',v_plan,
 'rewards',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rw) order by rw.sort_order,rw.title) from public.rewards rw where rw.student_id=p_student_id and rw.active=true),'[]'::jsonb),
 'ratings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('student_id',r.student_id,'weekday',r.weekday,'lesson_no',r.lesson_no,'rating',r.rating) order by r.weekday,r.lesson_no)
 from public.ratings r where r.student_id=p_student_id and r.week_start=p_week_start),'[]'::jsonb),
 'class_schedule_slots',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cs)) from public.class_schedule_slots cs where cs.class_id=v_class_id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'schedule_slots',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('student_id',ss.student_id,'weekday',ss.weekday,'lesson_no',ss.lesson_no,'enabled',ss.enabled) order by ss.weekday,ss.lesson_no)
 from public.student_schedule_slots ss where ss.student_id=p_student_id),'[]'::jsonb));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.weekly_reward_history(p_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(week_start date, goal text, weekly_shell_target integer, reward_title_snapshot text, checkin_completed boolean, checkout_completed boolean, good_count integer, rated_count integer, reward_redeemed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_school uuid;v_grade smallint;
begin
 select c.school_id,c.grade_level into v_school,v_grade
 from public.students s join public.classes c on c.id=s.class_id where s.id=p_student_id;
 if auth.uid() is null or not (public.is_teacher_of_student(p_student_id) or
  (v_school is not null and v_grade is not null and public.has_grade_access(v_school,v_grade))) then raise exception 'Keine Berechtigung'; end if;
 return query
 select w.week_start,w.goal,w.weekly_shell_target,w.reward_title_snapshot,w.checkin_completed,
   (w.checkout_self is not null),case when w.checkout_self is not null then coalesce(w.published_good_count,count(r.id) filter(where r.rating='good')::integer) else count(r.id) filter(where r.rating='good')::integer end,
   case when w.checkout_self is not null then coalesce(w.published_rated_count,count(r.id)::integer) else count(r.id)::integer end,w.reward_redeemed_at
 from public.weekly_plans w left join public.ratings r on r.student_id=w.student_id and r.week_start=w.week_start
 where w.student_id=p_student_id
 group by w.id order by w.week_start desc;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_reward_templates()
 RETURNS void

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=auth.uid() and role='teacher') then raise exception 'Nur für Lehrkräfte'; end if;
 insert into public.reward_templates(teacher_id,template_key,title,icon_key,shells_required,sort_order)
 select auth.uid(),v.template_key,v.title,v.icon_key,1,v.sort_order
 from (values ('ipad','iPad spielen','tablet',1),
('football','Fußball spielen','ball',2),
('drink','Durstlöscher','drink',3),
('game','Ein Spiel auswählen','game',4),
('paint','Freie Malzeit','paint',5),
('reading','Lesezeit am Lieblingsplatz','book',6),
('free_play','Freie Spielzeit','play',7),
('song','Ein Lied auswählen','music',8),
('help','Lehrkraft helfen','help',9),
('seat','Besonderen Sitzplatz auswählen','chair',10),
('friend','Mit einem Freund/einer Freundin arbeiten','friends',11),
('movement','Bewegungspause auswählen','move',12),
('class_activity','Klassenaktivität auswählen','group',13),
('wish_time','5 Minuten Wunschzeit','time',14),
('material','Lieblingsmaterial benutzen','star',15)) as v(template_key,title,icon_key,sort_order)
 on conflict (teacher_id,template_key) where template_key is not null do nothing;
end $function$
